q2_gaps: distributive adverbial 'in pairs' / 'in threes' (the agents act N at a time) — no licensed carrier for the quantity; the preposition-named oblique records the surface preposition but not the two-at-a-time reading, and Cardinality applies only to a group referent, not to an event's grouping of participants
review.notes: 'the Hollows' is treated as the capitalized-plural-label Name-only individual with no invented type atom, and the restrictive PP on the kind subject becomes a premise conjunct with 'at' routed to containment LocatedIn — both as written. Frequency 0.8 for 'often', the companion, and the bare-kind object in a habitual clause are also per doctrine.

review.notes: "the Hollows" correctly takes the capitalized-plural Name-only treatment (Name atom, no GroupOf, no invented type atom); "meet" is collective so the group event with no per-member rule and no tense (habitual + Every) is right, and "the forest edge" follows the N+N possessor/part route (Member edge + PartOf), not a fused compound.
